subject: Citrine Systems onboarding: procurement kickoff & privacy checklist
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alan Wright <awright@citrine-systems.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Citrine Systems — procurement kickoff and quick privacy asks

Hi Alan,

Thanks for choosing Redwood — excited to get Citrine Systems onboarded. I wanted to start a brief procurement kickoff so we can align on the PO path, billing contact, and the privacy items our procurement checklist requests. High-level asks to expedite the legal/procurement queue: 

- Point person for billing (name + email) and preferred PO process (send PO to billing@redwood.ai or upload to vendor portal)
- Current DPA: do you have a signed DPA with standard language, or would you prefer we share our DPA for signature?
- Subprocessor list (we typically need vendor names + locations + primary function)
- Data retention / deletion policy for hosted inference logs (approx. retention windows or categories)

If you can share existing documents (DPA, subprocessor spreadsheet, SOW/statement of work, or your PO template), that will help. I can also share our DPA draft and the PO template if that speeds things up.

Proposed next step: 30-minute kickoff tomorrow (Tue 07/21) to align on questions and timeline. Are you available 10–11am PT?

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: (none)
From: Alan Wright <awright@citrine-systems.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Li <emma@citrine-systems.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Citrine Systems — procurement kickoff and quick privacy asks

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers below and I attached the SOW and our current subprocessor export.

- Billing contact: Emma Li <emma@citrine-systems.com>, finance@citrine-systems.com (primary).
- PO process: We issue an internal PO and send as PDF to vendors; can send to billing@redwood.ai.
- DPA: We operate under our master DPA with a few negotiated clauses; I attached the current DPA. If Redwood prefers to push your DPA, we can switch — legal will need a quick review.
- Subprocessors: attached citrine_subprocessors.csv (includes name, country, and purpose).
- Retention: For production telemetry we currently retain logs for 180 days by default; for backups/archives it’s 3 years. We redacted a few internal product telemetry fields; we can discuss exact field sets on the call.

We can do Tue 07/21 at 10:30am PT — that works for Emma and me.

- Alan
Alan Wright
Head of IT & Procurement, Citrine Systems
awright@citrine-systems.com | +1 617-555-0220

Attachments: Citrine_SOW-v1.pdf, citrine_subprocessors.csv, Citrine_DPA-v3.pdf

Subject: Re: Citrine Systems — procurement kickoff and quick privacy asks

Alan — really helpful, thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple follow-ups so internal teams can route this correctly: 

1) Subprocessor list: the csv looks good — can you confirm whether any subprocessors process customer content (PII or inference payloads)? We need to mark those for our security intake. If yes, please flag them in the csv column labeled "processes_customer_data" or reply here with names.

2) DPA: we'll circulate the Citrine DPA to Privacy/Legal here for an initial review. To speed signature, could you accept some minor amendments around audit logs retention and right-to-delete timelines? If so, I'll attach a redline with our standard language ahead of the call.

3) PO flow: noted billing contact and process. Internal note: Marissa, once we confirm PO email we usually send the invoice instructions and tax forms.

Looking forward to the 10:30am PT slot tomorrow — I'll send calendar invite.

Thanks,
Jordan

Looping you in on Citrine — they confirmed billing contact and sent SOW + processor list (attached in vendor reply). Quick asks from procurement side before the 10:30am PT call: 

- Can procurement confirm accepted PO process for vendor-initiated PDF POs? We need to know whether Finance requires our vendor portal or if email is acceptable for Citrine.

Subject: Re: Fwd: Citrine Systems — procurement kickoff and quick privacy asks (need procurement checklist + PO routing)

Jordan / team —

Thanks for the heads up and for attaching vendor docs. Quick procurement checklist and next steps below so we can close this out within the week: 

1) PO routing: Finance confirmed that Citrine's process (PDF PO emailed to billing@redwood.ai) is acceptable for this account. We will accept emailed POs for the first year; after that we ask vendors to join the vendor portal. Please ensure the PO includes: legal name, remit address, tax ID, PO number, and line-level description referencing Redwood deal D-2026-1084.

2) Required paperwork before first invoice: W9 (Citrine is US entity), completed vendor onboarding form (I attached template), and bank remittance info. Marissa — please use the Citrine billing contact Emma Li and finance@citrine-systems.com.

3) DPA handling: Legal prefers to start from our standard DPA redline. Jordan — attaching redline (redwood-dpa-draft-2026-07.docx) and I will copy Priya Natarajan in Legal if Citrine wants to move quickly. Alan / Emma: if you can confirm acceptance of our small amendments around audit access and deletion timelines we can fast-track signature via DocuSign.

4) Subprocessors: I reviewed the csv — please flag any subprocessors that process customer inference payloads. From a procurement perspective, any processor that handles customer content or PII needs an SOC2 OR completed security attestation. If Citrine can mark those rows we will route Security intake.

5) Timeline: If Citrine provides flagged subprocessors and the completed vendor form by end of week (Fri 24 Jul), Finance can process the PO and we can get the first invoice out first week of Aug.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_template.pdf, redwood-dpa-draft-2026-07.docx

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
